prompt: 在2020年8月20日地方博物館活動日課堂活動中，在「8-Ⅳ-5：基本世界觀」能力練習中，Which sentence best summarizes this message: 'Please bring a reusable bottle on Friday.'？

options.text: Students should bring a new desk on Monday.
The bottle is not allowed on Friday.
The message is about a school holiday.
Students should bring a reusable bottle on Friday.
